newsitem.title: INDIA: Power failure led to trading delay - BSE director.
newsitem.headline: Power failure led to trading delay - BSE director.

text.p: Trading at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) was delayed on Monday because of a power breakdown, BSE director R.C. Mathur told Reuters.
"Trading started late due to a power supply breakdown at a substation of BEST (Bombay Electric Supply and Transport Undertaking) outside the BSE," Mathur said.
The problem was detected at 0800 hours, and the exchange contacted BEST immediately, he said.
Again there was a breakdown in the airconditioning unit of the computer room before power supply was finally restored.
There is no other reason for delay in trading, he added.
